cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the study is to teach students to solve theoretical and practical issues in the field of soil science and connect them with soil protection. The student will learn basic laboratory procedures of soil management and current properties of a soil at study area.
